IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: Family is the main focus of the Nice Guys. The majority of the money weraise goes to help families who have somehow fallen through the cracks. Amedical bill, a car repair, clothes needed after a house fire, awheelchair. We offer a hand-up not a hand-out.

IRS990.Desc: Grants and donations were made to individuals and charitableOrganizations benefiting San Diego residents in need. The Nice Guys VictoryFund provides assistance to wounded military personnel for rehabilitationAnd their families who have special needs are not provided by the militaryServices. A few of those needs are backpacks containing clothing, personalItems, games, etc for wounded service men and women in military hospitals,Modification of homes to handle wheelchairs and special needs, modificationOf cars or vans, providing families with transportation, housing and foodWhile they are in San Diego supporting their loved ones in the hospitals orRehab centers and all those special needs in between. Operation care giverProvides kits (15 items of basic hygiene and comfort) to us troops "farFrom the flagpole" (fob's, fop's cop's, mobile humvee bases, etc.) Kits areMailed to command level sargeants who distribute the supplies to theTroops who need them most.
